At low Mass the priest recites Agnus Dei clara. At solemn and sung Mass he recites it secreto; this distinct priestly recitation is retained alongside the audible singing of the Ordinary.

locator.section: De Missa solemni vespertina in Cena Domini, introductory prescription and no. 2

entries.claim: The evening Mass of the Lord’s Supper is solemn; where the clergy and priests required for that form are lacking, the usual Missa cantata rite is prescribed. Other Masses are forbidden except the Low Masses that the local ordinary may permit for the stated pastoral need and within the same evening hours. Low-Mass delivery metadata describes the permitted case, not an unrestricted choice of form.

locator.section: De musica sacra et sacra liturgia 25 b, 26 and 31 c

entries.claim: The faithful may sing Agnus Dei with the Ordinary at the second participation degree, also at Missa cantata. At low Mass they may recite it with the celebrant at the third degree. This permission neither asserts actual congregational participation nor replaces the celebrant’s distinct recitation.
